description: Returns the fixes, decisions and pitfalls this team already learned for the task at hand. Call it FIRST at the start of every coding task — before reading files or editing — with one line about the task, e.g. smart_recall("fix login redirect loop"). Finds lessons by meaning, not exact words. instance_id may be omitted; the configured instance is used — never guess one. Falls back to remember_context keys if no semantic match is found.

author.description: Who is recalling (optional). Counts cross-author reuse.

context_files.description: Files you are working on, e.g. ["src/auth/service.ts"]. Lessons learned around these files rank higher.

query.description: Natural language query to find relevant cached context

name: smart_recall
